title: On the equivalence of generalized solution concepts for systems of hyperbolic conservations laws in fluid dynamics
summary: We investigate the relation between several generalized solution concepts for nonlinear PDE systems from fluid dynamics. More precisely, we study measure-valued solutions, dissipative weak solutions, and energy-variational solutions. For the incompressible Euler equations, we prove the equivalence of all three concepts, provided that the energy inequality is formulated in the appropriate way.
